observation.command: cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/v1/auth/register" "/api/v1/auth/sign-up" "/api/v1/auth/signup" "/api/v1/auth/google" "/api/v1/auth/me" "/api/v1/projects" "/api/v1/me"; do printf "%-28s " "$p"; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/c.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Origin: https://app.claru.ai" -A "Mozilla/5.0" -d '{"email":"x@example.com","password":"Test1234!"}' "https://app.claru.ai$p"); echo -n "POST=$code "; head -c 110 /tmp/c.json | tr -d '\n'; echo; done; echo; echo "=== GET /api/v1/projects ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/d.json -w "%{http_code} " --max-time 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://app.claru.ai/api/v1/projects"; head -c 200 /tmp/d.json
